card.title: Earthquake mein zameen achanak slip kyun karti hai?
card.hook: 1906 ke San Francisco earthquake ke baad zameen ki movement ne ek powerful scientific explanation ko shape diya.

detail.real_life_scene: 18 April 1906 ko California mein powerful earthquake aaya aur San Andreas fault ke long section par ground movement dikhi. 1910 mein Henry Fielding Reid ne elastic-rebound theory develop ki.
detail.central_question: Fault par pressure dheere build hokar shaking kaise bana sakta hai?

explanation.heading: 18 April 1906: San Francisco quake
explanation.text: 18 April 1906 ko California mein powerful earthquake aaya. San Andreas fault ke long section par ground rupture aur horizontal displacement record hue. Survey data aur damage observations ko scientists ne detailed reports mein study kiya.

explanation.heading: Fault par rock blocks ka movement
explanation.text: Fault Earth ki crust mein ek fracture hai jahan rock blocks relative movement kar sakte hain. Kuch sections friction ke kaaran atak sakte hain, jabki surrounding rocks dheere deform hote rehte hain. Jab fault slip karta hai, stored elastic strain ka kuch hissa release hota hai. Energy seismic waves ke form mein travel karke ground shake kar sakti hai.

explanation.heading: 1910: Reid ki elastic-rebound theory
explanation.text: Henry Fielding Reid ne 1910 mein observations ke analysis se elastic-rebound theory develop ki. Yeh earthquake mechanics ka important model bana. Real faults complicated hote hain, isliye simple rubber-band example unki poori behaviour capture nahi karta.

explanation.heading: Friction temporarily rokta hai
explanation.text: Earth ki tectonic plates move karti rehti hain, lekin fault surfaces friction ke kaaran temporarily locked reh sakti hain. Nearby rocks deform hote hain; sudden slip se stored strain ka portion seismic waves ke roop mein release hota hai.

explanation.heading: Magnitude aur shaking intensity alag hain
explanation.text: Magnitude released energy ka measure hai, jabki local shaking intensity distance aur ground conditions se vary karti hai. Elastic rebound basic mechanism explain karta hai, but exact earthquake time predict karna reliably possible nahi. Building safety aur preparedness risk reduce karne mein important hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Earthquake-resistant construction, hazard maps aur preparedness ground shaking ke risks kam karne mein help karte hain. Fault ke paas rehna hi risk ka eklauta factor nahi hai. Building design aur neeche ki mitti bhi shaking se hone wale damage par asar daal sakti hai.

reality_check.established: 1906 earthquake ki measurements ne elastic-rebound model ko establish karne mein help ki.
reality_check.misconception: Scientists generally earthquake ka exact day, time aur location reliably predict nahi kar sakte.

detail.status: Proven: elastic rebound mechanism; exact earthquake timing predict nahi hoti

card.title: Plastic se electricity? Har plastic insulator nahi!
card.hook: Wire par plastic cover electricity se bachata hai. Phir kuch special polymers current kaise conduct karte hain?

detail.real_life_scene: 1970s ke end mein Hideki Shirakawa, Alan MacDiarmid aur Alan Heeger ne conductive polymers par kaam kiya, aur 2000 mein teeno ko Chemistry Nobel mila.
detail.central_question: Kya plastic jaisi materials electricity conduct kar sakti hain?

explanation.heading: 1970s ke end: conductive polymers
explanation.text: 1970s ke end mein Hideki Shirakawa, Alan MacDiarmid aur Alan Heeger ne conductive polymers par important work kiya. Unhe 2000 Chemistry Nobel mila. Polymer ek bahut bada molecule hota hai jo smaller repeating units ki long chain se bana hota hai.

explanation.heading: Aam plastic insulator kyun hai
explanation.text: Common plastic ka structure electrons ko aasani se move karne nahi deta, isliye woh insulator ho sakta hai. Lekin kuch specially structured polymer chains mein electrons ki movement possible hoti hai. Chemical treatment, jise doping kehte hain, material mein mobile charge carriers badhakar conductivity ko kaafi improve kar sakti hai.

explanation.heading: Sab polymers ek jaise conduct nahi karte
explanation.text: Sab polymers ek jaisa conduct nahi karte, aur conductive polymer ka performance copper jaisa hi ho, yeh bhi zaroori nahi. Molecule ki structure, treatment aur working conditions matter karte hain. Flexible electronics ke liye material ka bend hona ek useful property ho sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Conjugated chains aur delocalised electrons
explanation.text: Conjugated polymer chains mein alternating bonding arrangement electrons ko chain ke along delocalise karne ki possibility deta hai. Doping charge carriers introduce ya alter kar sakti hai, jis se conductivity increase hoti hai. Molecular structure aur processing se result strongly change hota hai.

explanation.heading: Sensors, displays aur flexible electronics
explanation.text: Conductive polymers sensors, displays aur flexible-electronics research mein useful ho sakte hain. Lekin conductivity ke saath stability, lifetime, cost aur manufacturing bhi important hain. Ordinary plastic bag ko electricity conductor assume karna unsafe aur scientifically incorrect hoga.

detail.real_world_connection: Conductive aur semiconductive polymers electronics aur special coatings ke research aur applications mein use hote hain. Electronic device banate waqt researchers conductivity ke saath material ki durability aur manufacturing cost bhi consider karte hain. Har application ko ek jaisi properties nahi chahiye.

reality_check.established: Certain specially prepared polymers electricity conduct kar sakte hain.
reality_check.misconception: Is discovery ka matlab yeh nahi ki ghar ka har plastic bag ya cable cover electrical conductor hai.

detail.status: Proven: kuch polymers conduct karte hain; copper jitna nahi

card.title: Chicago ki poisoned capsules aur medicine seals ki kahani
card.hook: 1982 mein medicines ke saath tampering se deaths hui. Packaging par safety seals ko phir zyada importance mili.

detail.real_life_scene: 1982 mein Chicago area mein saat logon ki death cyanide-containing acetaminophen capsules lene ke baad hui. Uske baad packaging par tamper-evident features ki importance badhi.
detail.central_question: Tamper-evident packaging kyun important bani?

explanation.heading: 1982 Chicago: poisoned capsules
explanation.text: 1982 mein Chicago area mein seven logon ki death cyanide-containing acetaminophen capsules lene ke baad hui. CDC ke historical account ke mutabik is incident ke baad kai over-the-counter medicines ko tamper-resistant packaging mein repack kiya gaya. Yeh public-health aur consumer-safety history ka serious case tha.

explanation.heading: Tampering aur tamper-evident features
explanation.text: Tampering ka matlab hai kisi product ko unauthorized tareeke se change karna. Tamper-evident feature aisa seal ya packaging design hai jisme kholne ya badalne ke kuch signs nazar aa sakte hain. Idea yeh hai ki consumer ya seller suspicious product ko use ya sell karne se pehle identify kar sake.

explanation.heading: Seal guarantee nahi hoti
explanation.text: Koi bhi seal absolute guarantee nahi hoti. CDC ne later incidents mein bhi packaging safeguards ki limits note ki. Manufacturers, regulators, sellers aur consumers sabke checks important hain. Different countries mein packaging requirements aur practices different ho sakti hain.

explanation.heading: Seals ka goal kya hai
explanation.text: Seals ka goal tampering ko difficult banana aur opening ke visible signs provide karna hai, contamination ko magically impossible banana nahi. Packaging ke saath distribution controls, recalls aur investigation systems bhi consumer safety mein contribute karte hain.

explanation.heading: Seal broken ho to kya karein
explanation.text: Agar seal broken, missing ya suspicious ho toh product use na karein aur local seller ya relevant authority ko report karein. Product-specific guidance follow karein. 1982 case ke details aur subsequent regulatory responses ko broader context mein dekhna chahiye; har packaging type equally protective nahi hoti.

detail.real_world_connection: Medicine kharidte waqt packaging ki condition aur expiry check karein. Seal suspicious lage toh use na karein; pharmacist ya relevant local authority se guidance lein. Safety seal ko khud repair karke medicine use karna achha idea nahi. Seller ko problem batakar sealed replacement ya appropriate guidance maangna better hai.

reality_check.established: Chicago ki 1982 poisonings aur subsequent packaging changes documented hain.
reality_check.misconception: Intact-looking packaging risk ko kam kar sakti hai, lekin har form of contamination ko perfectly detect nahi karti.

detail.status: Proven: tamper-evident packaging aayi; koi seal absolute guarantee nahi

card.title: Saturn ke moon ke neeche ocean ka clue kahan se mila?
card.hook: Ek icy moon se paani aur ice ke jets space mein nikle. Cassini spacecraft ne unse kya seekha?

detail.real_life_scene: 2015 mein Cassini mission ke data se Enceladus ke plumes ka analysis hua — ice particles mein salts aur doosre measurements ne underground liquid water ka case strengthen kiya.
detail.central_question: Enceladus ke icy shell ke neeche ocean ka evidence kya hai?

explanation.heading: Cassini aur Enceladus ke plumes
explanation.text: NASA ka Cassini mission Saturn system ko study kar raha tha jab scientists ne Enceladus naam ke moon ke south pole ke paas icy plumes observe kiye. Plumes matlab material ki sprays jo surface ke cracks se space ki taraf nikalti hain. Cassini ne unmein water vapour aur ice particles ko investigate kiya.

explanation.heading: Ice particles mein salts
explanation.text: Ice particles mein salts aur dusre measurements ne underground liquid water ka case strengthen kiya. Gravity data aur moon ke slight wobble—yaani rotation mein chhota sa hilna—ko study karke scientists ne infer kiya ki icy shell ke neeche global ocean ho sakta hai. 2015 mein Cassini team ne global ocean ke liye strong evidence report kiya.

explanation.heading: 2015: multiple clues jude
explanation.text: Yeh conclusion multiple independent clues ko jodkar bana, direct ocean mein submarine bhejkar nahi. Ocean, organic chemicals aur possible energy sources astrobiology ke liye interesting hain, lekin inka hona life ka direct proof nahi hai.

explanation.heading: Plume material ko sample karna
explanation.text: Cassini ne plume material ko sample kiya, jisse subsurface environment ke baare mein indirect clues mile. Ocean icy shell ke neeche hai; directly liquid water mein jaakar instruments se complete survey nahi hua.

explanation.heading: Habitable hone ka matlab life nahi
explanation.text: Water ke saath chemical ingredients aur possible energy sources habitability research ke liye promising hain. Lekin organic compounds non-biological processes se bhi aa sakte hain, aur plumes ka observation living organisms detect karne ke equal nahi. Future missions further tests propose kar sakti hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Ocean worlds ki study batati hai ki liquid water sirf Earth ke familiar surface oceans tak limited nahi. Future missions deeper questions investigate kar sakti hain.

reality_check.established: Cassini data Enceladus ke icy crust ke neeche global liquid-water ocean ko strongly support karta hai.
reality_check.misconception: Enceladus par ocean ka evidence alien life milne ke barabar nahi hai.

detail.status: Proven: subsurface ocean ka strong case; direct access abhi nahi

card.title: Hepatitis C: blood transfusion ke baad missing virus ka clue
card.hook: Known hepatitis viruses ke tests negative the, phir bhi kuch patients beemar hue. Researchers ne missing cause dhoondha.

detail.real_life_scene: 2020 mein Hepatitis C virus ki discovery par Nobel diya gaya. Michael Houghton aur colleagues ne genetic techniques ki madad se unknown virus ka material identify kiya tha.
detail.central_question: Hepatitis C virus ki discovery tak scientists kaise pahuche?

explanation.heading: Known viruses negative, phir bhi illness
explanation.text: Hepatitis ka matlab liver mein inflammation, yaani sujan, hai. Hepatitis A aur B viruses identify hone ke baad bhi blood transfusion ke kuch cases mein hepatitis ka cause unexplained raha. Harvey Alter ke studies ne ek additional infectious agent ki taraf evidence diya.

explanation.heading: Houghton ne genetic technique se dhoondha
explanation.text: Michael Houghton aur colleagues ne genetic techniques ki madad se unknown virus ka material identify kiya. Is virus ko hepatitis C virus kaha gaya. Charles Rice ke later experiments ne yeh establish karne mein crucial contribution diya ki virus khud hepatitis cause kar sakta hai. 2020 Medicine Nobel in three scientists ko diya gaya.

explanation.heading: Sensitive blood tests ka raasta khula
explanation.text: Discovery se sensitive blood tests aur targeted medicines develop karne ka raasta khula. Hepatitis C infection kabhi chronic, matlab long-lasting, ho sakta hai aur liver ko damage kar sakta hai. Modern treatments se bahut log cure ho sakte hain, lekin individual care testing aur clinical advice par depend karti hai.

explanation.heading: Blood screening transmission kam karti hai
explanation.text: Blood screening se infected donations identify karne aur transfusion-related transmission reduce karne mein major progress hui. Modern direct-acting antiviral medicines many patients mein virus eliminate kar sakti hain, although access aur appropriate follow-up important hain.

explanation.heading: Saalon tak bina symptoms reh sakta hai
explanation.text: Hepatitis C ka infection kabhi years tak noticeable symptoms ke bina reh sakta hai, so risk-based testing valuable ho sakti hai. Virus identify hone ka matlab immediately cure mil jaana nahi tha: tests aur effective drugs develop karne mein years of further research lage.

detail.real_world_connection: Blood screening transmission risk ko reduce karne mein important hai. Exposure ya infection ka concern ho toh healthcare professional se test aur treatment ke options discuss karein.

reality_check.established: Hepatitis C virus liver disease ka established cause hai.
reality_check.misconception: Hepatitis ke saare cases ek hi virus se nahi hote; liver inflammation ke other causes bhi hain.

detail.status: Proven: virus identify hua; treatment effective, par screening zaroori

card.title: Phone ke andar chhota switch: transistor ne duniya kaise badli?
card.hook: 1947 mein ek chhote semiconductor device ne signals amplify kiye. Aaj ke chips tak ka safar wahan se kaise shuru hua?

detail.real_life_scene: 1947 mein Bell Labs ke John Bardeen aur Walter Brattain ne semiconductor material se signal amplify karne wala device banaya. 1956 mein is kaam par Nobel diya gaya.
detail.central_question: Transistor kya karta hai aur iska invention important kyun tha?

explanation.heading: 1947 Bell Labs: pehla transistor
explanation.text: 1947 mein Bell Labs ke John Bardeen aur Walter Brattain ne semiconductor material se signal amplify karne wala device demonstrate kiya. William Shockley ne aage junction transistor develop karne mein contribution diya. In teenon ko semiconductors aur transistor effect ke kaam ke liye 1956 Physics Nobel mila.

explanation.heading: Semiconductor ka behaviour
explanation.text: Semiconductor aisa material hai jiska electrical behaviour conductor aur insulator ke beech control kiya ja sakta hai. Transistor ka design current ko control karne deta hai. Ek transistor signal ko amplify kar sakta hai, yaani weak signal se stronger output control kar sakta hai. Digital circuits mein transistor electronic switch ki tarah bhi use hota hai.

explanation.heading: Ek chip par bahut saare components
explanation.text: Baad mein engineers ne bahut saare transistors aur other circuit components ek chip par banana seekha. Modern phone chips mein billions of transistors ho sakte hain. 1947 ka first device aur aaj ke advanced chips same nahi the; beech mein manufacturing, design aur materials ki kai generations aayi.

explanation.heading: Vacuum tubes ki jagah
explanation.text: Vacuum tubes bulky, power-hungry aur heat-producing ho sakti thi; transistors ne smaller and more reliable electronic circuits ke liye important alternative diya. Manufacturing advances ne integrated circuits ko practical banaya, jahan many components ek semiconductor chip par fabricate hote hain.

explanation.heading: Control signal doosre signal ko regulate karta hai
explanation.text: Ek transistor ka control signal doosre electrical signal ko regulate karta hai; energy amplified output ke liye power supply se aati hai, free mein create nahi hoti. Modern chips mein design, interconnections aur cooling bhi performance determine karte hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Phones, computers aur medical devices ke electronic circuits transistor technology par depend karte hain. Battery, software aur sensors bhi device ke liye zaroori hote hain.

reality_check.established: Bardeen aur Brattain ne 1947 mein early transistor demonstrate kiya; Shockley ne subsequent transistor development mein contribution diya.
reality_check.misconception: Transistor akela poora computer nahi hota; woh circuit ka ek important component hai.

detail.status: Proven: transistor ne vacuum tubes replace kiye; scaling chalti rahi

card.title: Diarrhoea mein ORS: sugar aur salt paani absorb karne mein kaise help karte hain?
card.hook: Sirf paani dena kaafi nahi tha. 1968 mein Dhaka mein glucose aur salt ka oral solution 29 patients par test hua — aur IV drip ki zaroorat bahut kam ho gayi.

detail.real_life_scene: 1968 mein Richard Cash aur David Nalin ne Dhaka ke cholera lab mein glucose aur salt ka oral solution 29 patients par test kiya. Baad mein West Bengal ke ek refugee camp mein dikha ki ye hospital ke bahar bhi kaam karta hai.
detail.central_question: ORS solution diarrhoea mein body ko fluids wapas paane mein kaise help karta hai?

explanation.heading: 1968 Dhaka: 29 patients ka test
explanation.text: WHO diarrhoea management mein oral rehydration salts, ya ORS, ko important treatment maanta hai. ORS sachet ke salts aur glucose ko instructions ke mutabik safe water mein milaya jaata hai. Yeh solution lost water aur important salts replace karne mein help karta hai. 1968 mein Richard Cash aur David Nalin ne Dhaka ke Pakistan Cholera Research Lab mein glucose aur salt ke oral solution ko 29 patients par test kiya. 1979 se BRAC ke workers ne rural Bangladesh mein 12 million mothers ko ye solution banana aur use karna sikhaya.

explanation.heading: Glucose aur sodium saath absorb hote hain
explanation.text: Small intestine ki cells glucose aur sodium—ek important salt component—ko absorb karne ke liye connected transport system use karti hain. Is process ke saath water absorption bhi support hoti hai. Diarrhoea ke dauran bhi yeh mechanism kaam kar sakta hai. Isliye correct proportions important hain: bahut concentrated mixture helpful hone ke bajay harmful ho sakta hai.

explanation.heading: ORS dehydration rokta hai, infection nahi
explanation.text: ORS dehydration ko prevent ya treat karne mein help karta hai, lekin infection ki cause ko directly eliminate karna uska main kaam nahi. Severe dehydration mein urgent medical care aur kabhi intravenous fluids ki zaroorat pad sakti hai. Infants aur children mein deterioration jaldi ho sakti hai.

explanation.heading: Packet ka exact paani zaroori hai
explanation.text: ORS banate waqt packet par diya exact paani ka volume use karein; extra sugar ya kam water concentration change kar sakta hai. Breastfeeding aur age-appropriate feeding generally continue karna important hai; local clinician ki advice follow karein.

explanation.heading: Ye signs doctor tak jaane ke hain
explanation.text: Child bahut sust ho, pee na pa raha ho, aankhen dhansi hui hon, stool mein blood ho ya dehydration worsening ho, toh urgent medical assessment seek karein. ORS diarrhoea ko instantly stop nahi karta; main purpose fluids aur salts replenish karna hai.

detail.real_world_connection: Packet par diya exact water amount aur preparation instructions follow karein. Child unusually sleepy ho, pee na pa raha ho, blood in stool ho, ya dehydration severe lage toh promptly medical help lein.

reality_check.established: ORS solution intestinal absorption ke through water aur salts replace karta hai.
reality_check.misconception: ORS ko diarrhoea turant rokne ki medicine ya severe dehydration mein medical care ka replacement na samjhein.

detail.status: Proven: ORS dehydration rokta hai; infection ka cause treat nahi karta

sources.title: Tropical Medicine and Infectious Disease (2022): Oral Rehydration Salts, Cholera, and the Unfinished Urban Health Agenda

card.title: Samundar ke colourful corals safed kyun ho jaate hain?
card.hook: Garam paani coral aur uske tiny partners ka relationship bigaad sakta hai. Safed coral kya hamesha dead hota hai?

detail.real_life_scene: 2016 mein Great Barrier Reef ke northern third — lagbhag 800 km ke hisse — mein catastrophic bleaching hui. NOAA ke satellite data ke mutabik har reef ka bleaching level wahan ke local heat exposure se tightly linked tha.
detail.central_question: Coral bleaching kya hai aur coral recover kar sakta hai?

explanation.heading: Coral colonies aur unke tiny partners
explanation.text: Corals chhote marine animals ki colonies bana sakte hain; kai species milkar coral reefs banati hain. Unke tissues mein microscopic algae, yaani chhote photosynthetic partners, rehte hain. Yeh algae sunlight ka use karke food banate hain aur coral ko energy provide karte hain.

explanation.heading: Garmi mein relationship stress mein aa jaata hai
explanation.text: Jab paani unusual time tak bahut garam rahe, toh coral aur algae ka relationship stress mein aa sakta hai. Coral algae ko expel kar sakta hai ya unke pigments kam ho sakte hain. Isse coral ka white skeleton zyada clearly dikhne lagta hai. Is process ko bleaching kehte hain.

explanation.heading: Bleached coral turant dead nahi hota
explanation.text: Bleached coral zaroori nahi ki immediately dead ho. Agar conditions time par improve ho jaayen, toh coral algae ke saath relationship recover kar sakta hai. Lekin severe ya prolonged stress se coral mar bhi sakta hai. Repeated bleaching aur other pressures reef recovery ko difficult bana sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Reefs habitat aur coastal protection dete hain
explanation.text: Coral reefs fish habitat, coastal protection aur local livelihoods ke liye important hain. Sustained marine heat stress ke alawa pollution, disease aur destructive practices bhi reefs ko harm kar sakte hain. Recovery bleaching ki severity aur local conditions par depend karti hai.

explanation.heading: 1998, 2002, 2016 aur back-to-back events
explanation.text: Bleaching ek visible warning hai, exact survival outcome nahi. Scientists temperature records aur reef surveys se stress track karte hain. Local protection pressures reduce kar sakti hai, while long-term ocean warming address karna large-scale challenge hai. Great Barrier Reef par 1998, 2002 aur 2016 mein major mass-bleaching episodes hue, aur 2014 ke aas-paas se chalne wale global bleaching event ne kai locations par back-to-back saalon tak heat stress diya. NOAA ke Coral Reef Watch ke mutabik 2016 ki severity 1998 aur 2002 se zyada thi.

detail.real_world_connection: Coral reefs fish aur other sea life ko habitat dete hain aur coastal communities ke liye important hain. Ocean warming aur local pollution jaise pressures ko samajhna reef protection mein useful hai.

reality_check.established: Heat stress coral bleaching trigger kar sakta hai, aur kuch bleached corals recover kar sakte hain.
reality_check.misconception: White dikhne wala coral automatically dead nahi hota; lekin bleaching serious warning sign hai.

detail.status: Proven: heat stress se bleaching hoti hai; recovery har reef par alag

sources.title: NOAA Coral Reef Watch: Global warming and recurrent mass bleaching of corals (Nature, 2017)

card.title: Aurora polar regions se bahar kyun nikal jaati hai?
card.hook: 10 May 2024 ko Earth par G5 conditions observe hue — extreme category. Aise storms mein aurora unusual latitudes tak dikhti hai, aur power grid par risk banta hai.

detail.real_life_scene: Friday, 10 May 2024 ko 6:54 p.m. EDT par Earth par G5 conditions first observe hue, aur NOAA ke Space Weather Prediction Center ne usi din 23:58 UTC par alert publish kiya. Extreme storms mein aurora unusual latitudes tak dikhti hai.
detail.central_question: Polar regions ke paas sky mein aurora lights kaise dikhti hain?

explanation.heading: Magnetic field charged particles ko modne deta hai
explanation.text: Earth ke aas-paas magnetic field hota hai, jo space se aane wale charged particles ki motion ko influence karta hai. Sun se continuously charged particles ki stream nikalti hai, jise solar wind kehte hain. Strong solar activity kabhi Earth ke magnetic environment mein extra disturbance la sakti hai.

explanation.heading: Particles atmosphere ki taraf accelerate hote hain
explanation.text: Magnetic field se linked processes kuch charged particles ko atmosphere ki taraf accelerate karte hain. Jab yeh particles upper atmosphere mein oxygen aur nitrogen jaise gases se interact karte hain, gas ke particles energy le sakte hain. Jab woh energy release karte hain, light emit hoti hai. Gas aur altitude ke hisaab se colours aur patterns change ho sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Polar regions, aur strong storms mein aur door
explanation.text: Auroras aksar magnetic polar regions ke paas visible hoti hain. Strong geomagnetic storms ke dauran woh usual areas se lower latitudes tak bhi dikh sakti hain. Jupiter jaise other planets par bhi auroras observe hui hain, lekin unke exact driving processes Earth se different ho sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Excitation se light: oxygen aur nitrogen
explanation.text: Aurora upper atmosphere mein gas molecules aur atoms ke excitation se light produce karti hai. Oxygen commonly green aur kabhi red light se linked hoti hai; nitrogen blue ya purple hues mein contribute kar sakta hai. Actual colours altitude aur conditions par depend karte hain.

explanation.heading: Sundar, par satellites aur grid ke liye risk
explanation.text: Aurora sundar hai lekin strong geomagnetic storm satellites aur power systems ke liye operational risks bhi la sakti hai. Human eyes aur camera ki sensitivity different hone se photograph mein colours visually observed scene se zyada intense dikh sakte hain. 10 May 2024 ko Earth par G5 conditions observe hue — NOAA ke Space Weather Prediction Center ka alert usi din 23:58 UTC par publish hua, aur G5 conditions 6:54 p.m. EDT par first observe hue the.

detail.real_world_connection: Space-weather monitoring se satellite operators aur electricity utilities ko disturbances ke baare mein warnings mil sakti hain. Aurora beautiful visual signal ho sakti hai, par space weather ka effect technology par bhi pad sakta hai.

reality_check.established: Auroras upper-atmosphere gases aur energetic charged particles ke interactions se produce hoti hain.
reality_check.misconception: Aurora clouds par paint hui light nahi hai, aur Jupiter ki har aurora exactly Earth wale process se nahi banti.

detail.status: Proven: aurora ka mechanism settled; G5 storms grid ke liye risk hain

sources.title: NOAA/NWS Space Weather Prediction Center: G5 Conditions Observed! (10 May 2024)
